title: Practical Guide to Portfolio Diversification
content: A practical portfolio diversification strategy balances risk and growth across multiple dimensions: 1. Asset Class Diversification (equities for growth, fixed income for stability, gold for inflation hedging). 2. Sub-Category Diversification (large cap, mid cap, flexi-cap equities; liquid and short-duration debt). 3. Periodic Rebalancing: Reviewing and adjusting asset allocation annually to maintain target risk profiles.
